mission: Build a reusable Playwright helper that successfully authenticates against FoodKing API + injects idempotency keys, unblocking the Wave B latency measurement agent.

files_created.purpose: Admin Sanctum token issuance via Playwright APIRequest (no browser). Exposes loginAdmin() + createApiContext() + resolveApiKey().
RFC-4122 v4 UUID generator with optional prefix + idempotencyHeader() builder. Zero external dependency.
Kiosk-machine Sanctum token issuance (kiosk:order ability) via Playwright APIRequest. Distinct from existing browser-bound kiosk-order.js.
High-level kiosk order placement (quote → store → payment-confirm) via APIRequest. Returns { orderId, fiscalSequenceNo, idempotencyKey, latencyMs.total }.
Live-API integration test proving all 4 helpers wire together correctly.

test_breakdown.name: generateIdempotencyKey produces a prefixed RFC-4122 v4 UUID
idempotency keys are unique across rapid generation (N=256)
loginAdmin returns a usable Sanctum token + APIRequest context
loginKiosk returns a Sanctum token scoped to kiosk:order
admin + kiosk tokens are distinct (no cross-talk)

wave_b_root_cause_addressed.issue_1_kiosk_in_browser_token_revoke: RESOLVED — loginKiosk() uses Node-side APIRequest, never enters the browser context that triggers KioskLoginComponent.startAutoLogin re-issue/revoke races.
wave_b_root_cause_addressed.issue_2_missing_x_api_key_header: RESOLVED — every APIRequest context built by these helpers stamps X-API-KEY from resolveApiKey() (env var precedence, .env fallback).
wave_b_root_cause_addressed.issue_3_direct_db_insert_no_kds_render: PARTIALLY ADDRESSED — placeOrder() goes through the real /frontend/order endpoints so domain events fire normally and KDS receives the broadcast as in production. Direct-DB insert path is now unnecessary.
wave_b_root_cause_addressed.issue_4_kds_bump_422_missing_idempotency: RESOLVED — generateIdempotencyKey() + idempotencyHeader() provide drop-in headers for any idempotency-protected endpoint, including the KDS bump.

source_priority: 2. Parse REPO_ROOT/.env line `MIX_API_KEY=<value>` (zero dependency, no dotenv)

admin_login.important_note: Token is at ROOT of body, NOT nested in body.data. Wave B latency agent likely assumed { data: { token } }.

latency_burst_pseudocode: const { apiContext, kiosk, token } = await loginKiosk(); // ONE login

next_actions_for_wave_b_relaunch: Re-run latency measurement agent — instruct it to import from tests/e2e/helpers/{admin-auth,kiosk-auth,place-order,idempotency-key}.js instead of rolling its own auth.
Run the demo spec first as a sanity gate: PLAYWRIGHT_NO_WEB_SERVER=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/helpers/example-using-helpers.spec.js
Expected baseline overhead from helpers alone: ~50 ms for admin login, ~290 ms for kiosk login (single round-trip each, no Chromium boot).
If kiosk throttle:kiosk-login is hit during stress, call clearFoodKingRateLimits() from helpers/rate-limit.js before each batch.
word_cap_compliance: report under 800 words by intent (JSON-structured findings)
